prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1342; do not mention it.)
text: I was stopped at a red light on the main road in Baytown, Texas, waiting to turn left, when I felt a hard jolt from behind. The vehicle that hit me did not appear to slow down at all. My car was pushed forward into the intersection, and I braced myself on the steering wheel with my right hand. Once the vehicles stopped moving, I stepped out and saw that the other driver was on their phone and looked shaken but unhurt. My right wrist was throbbing badly, and I could not grip anything properly. A bystander called for help, and paramedics checked me at the scene before I was taken to the emergency room. X-rays later showed a fracture in my wrist, and I have been told I will need a cast and follow-up visits with a specialist. I have photos of both vehicles and the damage to my rear bumper, and I can provide them on request.
